verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or batch operation capability: no bulk contact import or update, no batch call scheduling, and no multi-select actions in the UI. The nearest items are only adjacent. These are the REST API for managing contacts and scheduling calls (with no batch support stated), conversation filtering, automatic data-retention deletion, and recurring scheduled workflows, which are a schedule rather than a bulk action.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
